title: China ends offshore trust income tax transition with over RMB160 billion declared
summary: China&\#x27;s tax authority said on November 11 that the 90-day transition period for taxing offshore trust income ended, with more than RMB160 billion in personal income tax declared, including over RMB120 billion collected in October, which it said drove nearly 90% growth in national personal income tax revenue that month. Under a July 24, 2026 notice from the Ministry of Finance and the tax authority, taxpayers who declared and paid within the 90-day window avoid late-payment surcharges.
